payload.title: Edit pages as pages, not as Stories: a page editor (probably the wiki)
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-03: Page is not a Story type, but the Story editor still offers a Page button so existing pages stay editable. We might need a specific way to edit pages as pages instead of trying to shoehorn them into stories; probably the wiki will end up being that. Follow-up only, not built in the story-types PR: decide the page editing surface, then remove the Page button from the Story editor.
